SmartShift: Optimizing Hotel Staff Scheduling Using Data Analytics

🧠 Problem Statement

Hotels often struggle to manage staff shifts effectively due to unpredictable guest demand, lack of alignment with employee preferences, and manual scheduling practices. This results in overstaffing, understaffing, increased operational costs, and decreased employee satisfaction.

This project is designed to analyze hotel operations and employee data to:
	•	🏨 Minimize labor costs while ensuring service quality.
	•	👨‍👩‍👧 Match shift schedules with employee preferences and availability.
	•	📈 Forecast staffing needs based on occupancy trends and seasonality.
	•	🔔 Alert hotel managers to hire or reduce staff ahead of time.

🎯 Objectives (Phase 1 - Data Analyst Focus)
	•	Build realistic synthetic datasets that simulate hotel operations.
	•	Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) on labor cost, shift coverage, and demand.
	•	Visualize insights related to workload, employee scheduling conflicts, and department-level trends.
	•	Create dashboards to support hotel owners in decision-making.
	•	Lay the foundation for predictive and optimization modeling.

🔮 Future Additions (Post-Hiring Phase)
	•	Predict guest occupancy to proactively plan staffing.
	•	Optimize shift scheduling using linear programming or ML algorithms.
	•	Create an interactive web app for managers (e.g., using Streamlit).
	•	Add employee satisfaction and performance tracking features.

🛠️ Tools & Technologies
	•	Python (Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn)
	•	Excel/CSV for data entry and simulation
	•	Tableau / Power BI / Streamlit for dashboards
	•	GitHub for version control and portfolio presentation
